description: This file contains utility functions for list manipulation, including push, prepend, chunk, last, first, rest, initial, sortAlpha, reverse, compact, uniq, inList, without, has, slice, mustSlice, and concat, implemented in Go. It is part of the 'sprig' package and references standard libraries such as fmt, math, reflect, and sort.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the input variadic list as a slice of interface{}.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Appends a value to a list, panics on error.

methods.name: mustPush
methods.description: Helper that appends a value to a list, returning error if list type is incompatible.

methods.name: prepend
methods.description: Prepends a value to a list, panics on error.

methods.name: mustPrepend
methods.description: Helper that prepends a value to a list, returning error if list type is incompatible.

methods.name: chunk
methods.description: Splits a list into chunks of specified size, panics on error.

methods.name: mustChunk
methods.description: Helper that splits a list into chunks, returning error if list type is incompatible.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last element of a list, panics on error.

methods.name: mustLast
methods.description: Helper that returns the last element, with error handling.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first element of a list, panics on error.

methods.name: mustFirst
methods.description: Helper that returns the first element, with error handling.

methods.name: rest
methods.description: Returns all elements except the first, panics on error.

methods.name: mustRest
methods.description: Helper that returns the rest of the list, with error handling.

methods.name: initial
methods.description: Returns all elements except the last, panics on error.

methods.name: mustInitial
methods.description: Helper that returns all but the last element, with error handling.

methods.name: sortAlpha
methods.description: Sorts a list alphabetically and returns a string slice.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses a list, panics on error.

methods.name: mustReverse
methods.description: Helper that reverses a list, with error handling.

methods.name: compact
methods.description: Removes empty elements from a list, panics on error.

methods.name: mustCompact
methods.description: Helper that compacts a list, with error handling.

methods.name: uniq
methods.description: Removes duplicate elements from a list, panics on error.

methods.name: mustUniq
methods.description: Helper that returns unique elements, with error handling.

methods.name: inList
methods.description: Checks if an element exists in a list.

methods.name: without
methods.description: Returns list excluding specified elements, panics on error.

methods.name: mustWithout
methods.description: Helper that excludes elements, with error handling.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a list contains an element, panics on error.

methods.name: mustHas
methods.description: Helper that checks for element existence, with error handling.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a slice of a list based on indices, panics on error.

methods.name: mustSlice
methods.description: Helper that slices a list, with error handling.

methods.name: concat
methods.description: Concatenates multiple lists into one.
